record.one_liner: Application monitoring and error tracking platform with a public REST web API for orgs, teams, projects and issue data.
record.auth_notes: Internal integrations generate org-wide auth tokens with no OAuth flow. Public integrations use OAuth2 with access tokens that expire after 30 days and refresh tokens. Legacy API keys and DSN-based auth exist but are limited; DSN auth is only for some endpoints.
record.access_notes: Docs describe one free Developer plan alongside paid Team, Business and Enterprise plans; new accounts get a 14-day trial then fall back to the free Developer plan. Internal-integration tokens are created in Settings > Developer Settings. critic: re-derived access, confirmed self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: Versioned REST API at sentry.io/api/0 covering account-level resources and data export. Beta endpoints may change. Region-specific hosts are supported.

evidence.quote: Internal integrations automatically generate an authentication token when configured.
Internal integrations don't require an OAuth flow.
Sentry has one free Developer plan and three paid plans
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
You can use the APIs to manage account-level resources, like organizations and teams, as well as manage and export data.
The base MCP server address is: https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
Sentry's MCP service is primarily designed for human-in-the-loop coding agents.
Internal integrations don't require an OAuth flow.
